Every paragraph around the DMA physical-page boundary, invalid and busy submissions, exact single-cycle DMA/DSP count-minus-one sequence, real/spurious IRQ ack/EOI, state-preserving cleanup and reinstall.

transport_guest.cleanup: Finished hardware shutdown/report closed, then exact executable/private-VM command checked before completed idle PID21328 stopped. Media/reports preserved.

adaptation: Seven foreground one-shots plus looping eighth voice; original source FD/ENV calculations and phase-preserving same-ID loop updates, nearest-source resampling.

Documented mono fold sums source left/right gains and divides by30. Signed contributions sum without blanket isolated-effect attenuation, saturate and re-bias; not an analog RF5c68 mixing fidelity claim.
Locked private IRQ7 stack acknowledges DSP before PIC EOI. Spurious IRQ7 has no DSP ack/EOI. No DOS, allocation, DSP command polling or mixing inside audio ISR.
Foreground-only submissions borrow no caller buffer after return. Teardown masks DMA before reset/vector restoration/free; restores only the audio PIC bit while preserving other clients.
limitations: Not continuous playback: each block is rearmed in foreground. This initial transport has gaps and is not an acceptable final game-audio service strategy under slow rendering or blocking disk calls.
Audible quality is untested: exact generated PCM and DMA delivery are checked, not a recording of the host DAC output, physical hardware or analog filtering.
OPL2 music and game-facing listener/flags/API integration remain unimplemented. No playable game, full parity acceptance or FPS gain is claimed.
Elapsed ticks include startup synthesis, diagnostics, file I/O, mixing and waits; not isolated mixer or renderer performance.
Native mocks do not execute IRQ assembly, and emitted assembly checks alone are not hardware proof. Guest tests provide separate primary-emulator delivery/lifecycle evidence.
No optimization, spawning/freeze, UI, world/cache/heap budget, Towns source, emulator, ROM or user-medium change. Mutable diagnostic media stay ignored.
